test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

All blue are dogs.

No dog is silver

All pink are dogs.

**Conclusions : **

(I) Some pink are silver.

(II) No blue is pink is a possibility.

(III) Some blue are silver

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc61d416a5142f2e1714a356015da5951345bfd3660949c149fe27ff6dad4742.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pink are silver → **Does not** Follow (As, all pink are dogs and no dog is silver, So, no pink will be silver, therefore Some pink are silver will be definitely false)

II. No blue is pink is a possibility → Follow (As, all blue are dogs and all pink are dogs. and, no definite relation is given between blue and pink, so No blue is pink can be possible therefore it is definitely true)

III. Some blue are silver → Does not Follow (As, all blue are dogs and no dog is silver. So, no blue will be silver, therefore Some blue are silver is definitely false)

Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion II follows**".
